d: Miranda borrows money and doesn't tell Calvin  Floyd persuades Curtis to back up his new invention.
The Payne family must innovate as Mrs. Wellington returns with a vengeance  Calvin's relationship with Laura hits a turning point.
Malik takes caffeine pills irresponsibly  Curtis subs for Ella at a Help Center training program.
Curtis upsets Ella and must change his tune  Calvin confronts Miranda about talking to Laura  Miranda tells Calvin how she feels.

Malik is thrilled when he lands an interview with a councilman he idolizes, but he finds out that getting the job is only half the battle  Curtis fails a health inspection forcing him to modify his barbecue recipe to disastrous results.
CJ takes action when technology takes over the family.
In the middle of a city-wide egg shortage, Curtis searches for reasonably priced eggs  Lisa attempts to gain professional work experience by going to work with the Paynes.

Calvin's openness with his passwords lands him in trouble with Laura  the dynamics of professor Louis' relationship with Jazmine change as he makes a confession  Calvin Jr., on the other hand, is making Calvin's life difficult.
Calvin and Miranda have difficulty adjusting to living with Curtis and Ella.
Calvin and Miranda's divorce drama grows  Jazmine gets candid with Ella about wanting to have sex for the first time  Calvin doesn't want anybody talking to Miranda, including Ella.
Curtis uses his street resources to acquire a beat-up food truck for his barbecue business, only to learn the truck was used for something other than food  Malik and Lisa fight over roles.
Malik and Lisa have different must-watch television shows airing at the same time, but only one television  CJ and Malik suspect that Miranda is going on a date only to make Calvin jealous.
Malik and Summer work a crisis hotline  Curtis is eager to catch a criminal.

When Miranda asks Calvin to switch weekends with the boys, he agrees, totally disregarding the fact that he and Laura have plans  when Curtis and Floyd have a fight about business, Floyd decides to open his own food truck.
Tragedy strikes, forcing C.J. to spring into action  Lisa is pulled from each angle.
